calls.reason: OpenAI documents reasoning errors, while Bubeck and colleagues report broad general capabilities. These findings do not clearly settle whether GPT-4 falls short of the unspecified AGI standard.
NEWTON, the theory-of-mind variations and GSM-Plus document uneven or fragile performance across all three domains. Strong results on other tests do not erase those recurring reliability failures.

Richelieu's ablation supports weak unaided Diplomacy play, but Talk2Drive uses an external controller and Alter3 tests limited motions. The packet does not establish the driving and household-robot limitations.
Our World in Data reports nearly 13 trillion training tokens, suggesting substantial scale. It does not establish comparable GPT-3 corpus size or how much distinct internet content GPT-4 covered.

OpenAI reports weak complex-schema compliance and later structured-output improvements. Neither those tests nor its function-calling announcement measures dependable end-to-end operation under the claimed direct hookup.

OpenAI confirms continuity in training approach, and ConceptARC documents substantial abstraction failures alongside successes. Those results reveal flaws but do not establish the broader assertion that GPT-4 lacks real world understanding.
